info.name: Ticket Booking - Microservices
info.description:
All endpoints of the Ticket Booking system.

Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner (right-click the collection > Run). Each request has tests that check the expected status.

Folders 1 to 4 and 6 go through the API Gateway (port 8080). Folder 5 calls cinema, payment and notification directly, because those paths are not exposed by the Gateway.

Needs: Docker containers, config-server, eureka-server and all six services running.

request.description: 201 the first time, 409 if the email is already registered. Both are fine.
Gives a new pair. The old refresh token can never be used again.

item.name: 3. Catalog - organizer (via Gateway)
Seats of the new show (saves seat1..seat8)

exec: const seats = pm.response.json().sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id);
pm.test("50 seats, all AVAILABLE", function () { pm.expect(seats.length).to.eql(50); pm.expect(seats.every(s => s.status === "AVAILABLE")).to.be.true; });
for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { pm.collectionVariables.set("seat" + (i + 1), seats[i].id); }

item.description: Creates a fresh movie and show, then saves movieId, showId and seat1..seat8 for the next folders.

item.name: 4. Bookings (via Gateway)

request.description: Reserves in cinema-service, saves PENDING, pays, then marks CONFIRMED.

item.name: Seats after booking (seat1, seat2 are BOOKED)

exec: const seats = pm.response.json(); const booked = seats.filter(s => s.status === "BOOKED").length; pm.test("2 seats BOOKED", function () { pm.expect(booked).to.eql(2); });

request.description: 5 seats cost 1250, over the 1000 limit. The seats must be given back.

exec: const booked = pm.response.json().filter(s => s.status === "BOOKED").length; pm.test("still only 2 BOOKED, the declined seats were released", function () { pm.expect(booked).to.eql(2); });

item.name: Book a show that does not exist (404)

exec: const booked = pm.response.json().filter(s => s.status === "BOOKED").length; pm.test("no seat BOOKED", function () { pm.expect(booked).to.eql(0); });

item.description: Uses the show created in folder 3, so it can be run again and again.

item.name: 5. Direct calls (not exposed by the Gateway)

exec: pm.test("returns movie and seat details", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.movieName).to.exist; pm.expect(j.seats.length).to.eql(1); });
